description: The prisma feature (tdk resource --feature prisma, the only ORM the CLI supports) on a live stack: scaffold a backend with the feature, tdk up (the migrator runs prisma migrate deploy and the API waits for it), check DATABASE_URL is in the API container, and a routed health check that queries Postgres through DATABASE_URL. Replaces the #1291 allowlist entry for feature prisma in tests/e2e/axes.json (#1487, tracker #1279).
